capabilities: Pre-release single notes, folders, or multi-selections to a local Hexo repository
Review and edit category, tags, keywords, descriptions, and image alt text before writing
Copy local images to /images/<abbrlink>/ and fill cover and top-image metadata
Detect Hexo, Node.js, Git, and abbrlink configuration before running
Run two Hexo validation passes, create exactly one commit, and push only after explicit confirmation
extras: Desktop-only; not yet accepted into the community directory (BRAT or manual install offered). README includes detailed security section about filesystem access, process execution, and network use; the Community directory may show filesystem and process-execution warnings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in workflow for turning notes into Hexo posts, including copying images, filling metadata, validating the generated site, and making a controlled local Git commit.

relations.evidence: pre-releases selected Markdown files, folders, or multiple selections to a local Hexo repository
With BRAT, add FountainChan/obsidian-hexo-send as a beta plugin.

requires.name: Hexo repository with local Hexo CLI, hexo-abbrlink, Node.js, and Git
OpenAI-compatible endpoint key for optional AI metadata suggestions

summary: Hexo publishing assistant that pre-releases notes to a local Hexo repository, copying images, validating the site, and committing with explicit push confirmation.
